title: Apple Made a $299 HomeView iFixit Could BARELY Open 😬
description:
Apple's new $299 HomeView smart display just got torn down by iFixit — and it fought back hard.

The screen glue held on harder than on any Apple product iFixit has opened recently. Getting in, they ripped a connector and snapped a speaker in two. The screen's cables run through the hinge behind threadlocked screws, and the woofer cable is barely long enough to reconnect. The upside: the USB-C port is modular. iFixit calls it a surprising step backward after easier-to-fix iPads and HomePods.

Spec or wreck? Tell us below.
